# AlphaCode

> AlphaCode is a free, open-source (MIT) AI coding agent written in Rust that runs in your terminal. It can read a codebase, edit files, run tests, automate Firefox and control desktop apps. A built-in free AI provider means no API key is required to start; 54 model providers (Claude, GPT, Gemini, DeepSeek, Mistral, Ollama and any OpenAI-compatible endpoint) can be added later.

## Key facts
- License: MIT. Language: Rust. Platforms: Windows, macOS, Linux.
- 40+ built-in tools, swarm mode (parallel multi-agent execution), MCP server support, resumable sessions.
- Install (macOS/Linux): curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dragonked2/alphacode/main/scripts/install.sh | bash
- Install (Windows): iwr -useb https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dragonked2/alphacode/main/scripts/install.ps1 | iex

- [MCP servers guide](https://alphacli.github.io/mcp/): how AlphaCode discovers, authorizes and runs MCP servers
